caption: The drawing depicts a single, clear glass bottle with a stopper, rendered in grayscale pencil or ink. The bottle has a wide, rounded body that narrows at the neck, which is adorned with several horizontal ridges or rings. Around the shoulder of the bottle, there is a repeating scalloped pattern. The lower part of the bottle features intricate decorative motifs including starburst and fan shapes, each composed of fine lines to create a textured, cut-glass effect. The base of the bottle tapers into a short, faceted section. Beside the main view, there is an inset labeled "TOP VIEW OF STOPPER," which shows a circular, radial starburst pattern on the top of the stopper. The drawing is contained within a rectangular border, and the artist's name, "FRANCIS LAW DURAND," is inscribed in the lower right corner outside the border. The entire composition is monochrome, utilizing shades of gray with precise, detailed linework to indicate reflections and texture.
title: Decanter
